full.description: The lesson has structured grammatical-gender rules for this language and may render rule blocks and practice.

comparison_only.description: A reviewed comparison record may be shown, but the app must not synthesize missing agreement rules or practice.

unavailable.description: No defensible gender-system comparison record exists yet. Omit the language rather than guessing from language family.

pending_full_support_research.reason: These languages need independent structured agreement rules, exceptions, and practice constraints before lesson-level full support. Comparison facts do not grant full support.

promotion_rules: Global language tier never grants lesson-level full support automatically.
Do not infer a gender inventory from genealogical family or article count.
A full-support language must have explicit structured rules and safe practice constraints in the grammatical-gender grammar set.
A comparison-only language must have an explicit comparison record; missing data means omit, not 'no gender'.
Noun-class systems must be represented on their own terms rather than relabeled masculine/feminine/neuter.
